report.summary: Patient P-D006 (59, uninsured/self-pay, no transport benefit) needs med_cost and transport help. Highest medication cost is tiotropium inhaler (~$420/month, tier 5, 45-day refill gap). Screener reports no transportation access; neighborhood has high no-vehicle share (41%) and low-income tract. Scheduled primary-care visit 2026-10-23 at 14:00; transit feasibility could not be checked (no facility location on file). Eligibility: Medicaid Ride Line not eligible (uninsured); Senior Shuttle not eligible (age 60+). Paratransit requires ADA certification (up to 21 days). Med cost resources: Clinic Rx Fund (current patients, short-term copay help) and Community Pharmacy Assistance (Extra Help/manufacturer program applications; Extra Help unlikely given uninsured, but manufacturer programs may apply).

options.name: Clinic Rx Fund
options.how_to_access: Ask clinic social work/financial counselor to apply for short-term copay assistance for tiotropium (current patient).

options.name: Community Pharmacy Assistance
options.how_to_access: Request help applying to manufacturer patient-assistance programs for tiotropium inhaler.

options.name: Paratransit Info Desk
options.how_to_access: Call to apply for ADA paratransit certification; allow up to 21 days for decision.

options.name: Neighborhood Pharmacy Fund
options.how_to_access: Listed in directory but page content was not actionable; verify directly before relying on it.
